svg.text: One locked tower holds every drug: a turret of vial columns turns over a flush floor with one dosing disc, and the whole mechanism sits on one load cell.
SIDE CUTAWAY A–A — FRONT OF STATION ON RIGHT → (NOT TO SCALE)

only that column can be reached (CS column: 2FA + witness)

shared tray; the medic lifts the flap
• Not to scale. Shown at rest: column 6 (CS) is in front; the
disc's pocket is at REST, empty, outside the turret.
• The disc top is flush with the floor, so columns cross the
front position with no dip and no climb (Fig 7).
• No detent: S1 positions the turret and stays powered
until the disc is back at REST (Fig 5).
• The weighed module touches only the load cell; a vial
leaving down the fixed chute is a one-unit drop.
• Red markers: ≥ 2 mm to everything fixed (cover, walls,
chute, hatch parts). Light-blue line = slick floor top.
• The whole housing is the safe; the one-column hatch is
Smart Med Station · Hardware design v2.1 · 2026-10-07
